two_stage_boundary.stage_one: resolve_retirement_candidates or capture_retirement_snapshot; read-only bounded candidate evidence; no lease issuance and no mutation
two_stage_boundary.stage_two: exact snapshot plus explicit retirement_kind and optional exact successor enters execute_mutation

pre_dispatch_checks: descriptor is PLAN_RETIREMENT_DESCRIPTOR and read_write is write
plan_ref and snapshot identify the same exact Plan Subject
intent operation and logical target match plan_retirement and plan_ref
retirement_kind is explicit and is abandoned or superseded
successor_ref is exact, non-self, and present in the selected snapshot when superseded
trusted_context, MutationPreconditions, and CapabilityLease are present
CapabilityLease validates against the actual request before the transition
dispatch_steps: derive the descriptor contract hash and intent fingerprint
validate the lease using the actual snapshot revision and authority preconditions
invoke retire_plan(store, request) without refreshing or replacing the selected snapshot

selection_rules.one_candidate: present exact candidate but still require explicit retirement_kind

forbidden_shortcuts: reuse a lease after unknown outcome
route around the ingress to retire_plan
